ERW Steel Pipes Supplier in Gujarat | Maxxon Steel
Maxxon Steel is a leading ERW Steel Pipes Supplier in Gujarat, India. We manufacture high-quality Electric Resistance Welded (ERW) steel pipes and supply them across Gujarat for construction, infrastructure, fabrication, and industrial applications. 
Our Punjab-based manufacturing facility follows advanced production technology and strict quality control processes to ensure high strength, uniform wall thickness, and excellent weld integrity in every pipe. 
We actively supply ERW steel pipes to major industrial cities of Gujarat including Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, Bhavnagar, and surrounding regions with ready stock and timely delivery.
Our ERW Steel Pipe Categories
As a trusted ERW steel pipe supplier in Gujarat, we manufacture and supply pipes in multiple shapes and sizes: Round Steel Pipes, Square Steel Pipes, Rectangular  Steel Pipes, Custom Length & Thickness Pipes

Certifications Associated
Our ERW pipes are manufactured in compliance with the Indian Standard IS:4923,IS:3601 & IS:1161, ensuring they meet stringent quality and safety requirements. This certification reflects our dedication to providing products that adhere to national and international standards, offering our clients confidence in their performance and reliability.
1. Uncoiling and Leveling
2. Forming
3. Welding
4. Sizing and Shaping
5. Cutting
6. Inspection and Testing
Steel coils are uncoiled and flattened to prepare for forming.
The flattened steel is gradually shaped into a cylindrical form through a series of rollers.
The edges of the formed cylinder are heated and fused together using electric resistance welding, creating a strong seam without the need for filler material.
The welded pipe passes through sizing rollers to achieve precise dimensions and desired cross-sectional shapes (round, square, or rectangular).
Pipes are cut to the required lengths as per customer specifications.
Each pipe undergoes rigorous quality checks, including non-destructive testing, to ensure compliance with industry standards.
